captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a modern, cubic skyscraper or office building. It features a perfectly flat roof and a highly repetitive grid of rectangular window cutouts on all four vertical facades. The windows are neatly arranged in columns and floors, creating a uniform, architectural grid-like appearance with thin vertical and horizontal concrete pillars separating them.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric building generator in OpenSCAD. The script should allow users to customize the overall height, width, and depth of the building, as well as the number of window columns and the spacing (gutter) between them, automatically calculating and rendering the correct number of floors and window cutouts on all four sides.
captions.factory: The script uses a 'difference()' boolean operation to subtract window openings from a solid outer 'cube' representing the building shell. It calculates the window size and the number of floors dynamically based on the building height, width, and gutter parameters. Nested 'for' loops iterate through each floor and window column, translating and rotating smaller cubes to cut out rows of windows along both the width and depth of the building.
